title: My Hero Academia
premise: Eighty percent of the world has Quirks. Heroes are celebrities. Villains are everywhere. The rest is up to you.

lore.title: U.A. High School
lore.text: Japan's top hero academy, sitting in Musutafu. Students train through rescue drills, combat sparring, and internships with licensed pros. Entrance exams are brutal, and the faculty are working heroes.

lore.title: Musutafu
lore.text: Coastal city that is home to U.A. High and a dense hero scene. Agencies crowd the waterfront, and street crime keeps local pros busy. Residents are used to seeing heroes in action.

lore.title: Hosu City
lore.text: Industrial city that became the stage for the Hero Killer: Stain arc. Heroes there learned the cost of underestimating a villain. Warehouses and rail yards still show the damage.

lore.title: Tartarus
lore.text: Japan's most secure prison, built to hold the most dangerous villains. Quirk-dampening walls, sealed cells, and guards on constant alert. Its inmates are the ones nobody dares to free.

lore.title: League of Villains
lore.text: Shigaraki's criminal network, built on the legacy of All For One. Its members want to tear down the hero society and build a world without heroes. They operate from hidden bases and strike with precision.

lore.title: Hero Public Safety Commission
lore.text: The government body that licenses heroes and sets hero law across Japan. It issues Hero Licenses, runs the rankings, and can suspend pros who break the rules. Its rulings are final.

lore.title: Hero Agencies
lore.text: Private companies that employ licensed heroes and sell their services to the public. Agencies such as Endeavor Agency compete for sponsors and top-ranked pros. Rivalries between them can get ugly.

lore.title: Japan Police Force
lore.text: Regular police who work alongside heroes at major incidents. Officers handle crowd control and investigations, while the Commission decides how far heroes can go in the field. Friction between the two is constant.

lore.title: Quirks
lore.text: About eighty percent of humanity is born with a Quirk, a superpower that appears early and shapes a person's life. Quirks range from small tricks to world-changing powers. Society is built around who has one.

lore.title: Hero Licenses
lore.text: A Hero License must be earned through a grueling exam and issued by the Commission. Using a Quirk for heroics without one is illegal. Licenses can be revoked, which can end a career overnight.

lore.title: Hero Rankings
lore.text: Pros are ranked by public popularity, rescue record, and results. The top spots bring sponsors, media deals, and the most dangerous cases. The Number One spot is always up for grabs.

lore.title: Quirk Types
lore.text: Quirks come in broad types. Emitter Quirks project energy or matter, Enhancer Quirks boost the body, and Transformation Quirks change it, often at a cost. Combat styles grow out of these types.

lore.title: All Might
lore.text: Former Number One Hero and the living symbol of peace. He holds One For All and now trains the next generation at U.A. High. His time is running out, and he hides a wound few people know about.

lore.title: Izuku Midoriya (Deku)
lore.text: A Quirkless kid who inherited One For All from All Might. He trains at U.A. High and fights to become a hero who can save everyone. He pushes his body far past what it can safely take.

lore.title: Tomura Shigaraki
lore.text: Leader of the League of Villains and holder of All For One's Decay Quirk. Anything his fingers touch crumbles to dust. He hunts All Might and the hero society with cold, focused hatred.

lore.title: Endeavor (Enji Todoroki)
lore.text: A top-ranked fire hero who runs Endeavor Agency. Relentlessly ambitious and harsh with his family, he is hungry for the Number One title and resents All Might's shadow.

lore.title: All For One
lore.text: The original Quirk hoarder who steals Quirks from others and fuses them into his own power. He gave Shigaraki the Decay Quirk. Locked away in Tartarus, he still pulls strings from his cell.

lore.title: Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head)
lore.text: A homeroom teacher at U.A. High and a pro hero whose Quirk erases the powers of anyone he looks at. He is harsh on his students and quick to throw them into real danger.

lore.title: Katsuki Bakugo
lore.text: Deku's explosive rival with the Explosion Quirk and a short temper. Top of the class in raw power and a fierce competitor who shows up to every fight to win.
